contamination_policy: CCPD is public. Exact training-data contamination cannot be established locally; disclose this limitation and the provider policy for every model.
corpus_name: MiniBench shortest release with C2 100 paired positions 2026-10-28

engine.local_validation_environment: WSL Python invoking official Windows universal binary

generation_command.c2: python scripts/expand_xiangqi_c2_pairs.py prepare/prove/select/origins/stage; python scripts/verify_xiangqi_solution_trees.py --data-root <staging>; python scripts/expand_xiangqi_c2_pairs.py publish --work <reviewed-work>
generation_command.c2_source_policy: 100 distinct standard/focus pairs; old MiniBench pools plus traced legal intermediates; new sources reanalysed depth16/20; each condition independently re-proved; no shared PV requirement
generation_command.d3: Structural annotation inherited from the immutable 250-row parent pool; certified 100-row stratified selection is recorded in submission_manifest.json. Candidate annotation cannot overwrite the submitted release.
generation_command.m2: Derived from the same selected D3 positions with build_xiangqi_m2_from_d3.build; source IDs and same-FEN pairs are recorded in submission_manifest.json.
generation_command.submitted_selection: prepare_xiangqi_shortest_release.publish, seed=42; complete shortest trees required; see submission_manifest.json

generator_seed.c2: deterministic ordering over the fixed H2 release

intentional_overlap.C2: 50 standard/focus pairs from H2 parent sources; sources not selected into H2 are retained as minimal source evidence, not benchmark tasks.
intentional_overlap.D3_M2: 100 identical positions; D3 text versus M2 Chinese images; same output schema.

interpretation.c2: Same-FEN standard/focus pairs, each certified under its own active rules
interpretation.c2_horizon: 2*certified_shortest_attacker_moves-1 half-moves; total attacker moves, no reset or extension
interpretation.h2: Certified shortest forced mate; 50 short / 50 medium
interpretation.h2_horizon: 2*certified_shortest_attacker_moves-1 half-moves; total attacker moves, no reset or extension
interpretation.history_visual_gaps: Task gaps are not direct memory evidence; M2 separately scores explicit initial-board transcription.
interpretation.shortest_oracle: oracle and shortest_line_uci are certified shortest; h2/c2_analysis preserves historical reference evidence

model_service_snapshot: Evaluation configuration records model name, thinking flag and provider settings per run; no API key is persisted.

previous_release.migration_policy: Legacy ID mapping targets only the immutable legacy archive; no old answers are attached to replaced boards.

source_license.minibench_dataset_and_code: UNRESOLVED: repository has no top-level licence file

validation.variants: Every current C2 row has a complete bounded shortest-mate AND/OR proof; all legal defensive replies are covered in proof search. Exported DAGs retain locally shortest attacks and optimal delaying defences. Independent rules and terminal replay are also required. CPE depth-3 search is a metric/fallback, not this proof.
